anchors.quote: As we enter FY27, our focus remains on prioritising margin quality, working-capital efficiency, deeper customer partnerships and careful capital allocation.

The Pune facility is strategically important as it expands our capability in PCBA and busbar assemblies for automotive and electrification-led applications, and brings us closer to customers who increasingly want reliable, integrated and application-ready solutions.
earlier we used to supply regarding 55% in component, which goes up to 65% in year-on-year. And that is yielding almost 10-12% improved realization, as per the previous, per kg shunt realization.

the date of launch previously indicated by the Company, i.e., April 2026, has now been deferred due to pending permission/consents required to commence operations from the relevant government authorities.
On a standalone basis, revenue grew despite broadly stable product volumes, indicating better average realisation and increasing contribution from higher-value components.

In summary, FY26 gives us confidence that the strategic direction is right. We have a stronger platform, a more value-added mix, deeper customer relevance and a clearer path to building Shivalik into a more integrated precision components and assemblies business.

Shunt realization per kg trajectory - confirming 10-12% per-kg improvement holds as mix enriches further
OEM/Tier-1 customer order wins and wallet deepening announcements
Europe business momentum sustenance - sales mix from local presence and export traction
Americas market normalization signs - North America recovery in order inflow

outlook.summary: Management is executing a deliberate repositioning from commodity strip supply toward higher-value components and assemblies, with evidence of mix shift (55%→65% component ratio) and realization gains (10-12% per kg) already embedded in FY26 results. Pune facility is strategically critical for automotive/electrification growth but deferred pending government approvals; commissioning timeline clarity will be a near-term inflection point.

target_pe_rationale: Quality-focused precision engineering business with demonstrated operating leverage (OPM +250bps to 22.9% in FY26) and deliberate mix shift to higher-value components. While FY26 PAT growth of 24.8% will normalize, structural mix improvement and OEM deepening support sustainable 12-15% earnings CAGR
target_ps_rationale: Operating margin of 22.9% with 250bps expansion signals pricing power and successful mix execution. 16.8% net margin (FY26: ₹95.86cr PAT / ₹570.86cr revenue) underpins 2.2x P/S multiple, a mid-premium valuation reflecting improved margin profile and strategic shift toward integrated solutions with s
notes: Management issued NO explicit numeric guidance for FY27, FY28, FY29. Strategic narrative is clear (component mix shift 55%→65%, 10-12% realization improvement, Pune expansion, OEM deepening) but execution timeline uncertain: Pune deferred from April 2026 with no revised date pending government approvals.
